description.value:
You touch a creature and channel the Force to enhance one of its abilities, chosen from the list below; the chosen benefit lasts until the power ends. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

Strength. Advantage on Strength checks, and double carrying capacity.
Dexterity. Advantage on Dexterity checks, and no falling damage from falls of 20 feet or less while not incapacitated.
Endurance. Advantage on Constitution checks, and 2d6 temporary hit points, lost when the power ends.
Cunning. Advantage on Intelligence checks.
Wisdom. Advantage on Wisdom checks.
Splendor. Advantage on Charisma checks.

Casting this power with a force slot of 3rd level or higher lets you enhance one additional creature for each slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 2
